title: Chestnut short feathered shag
caption: A fictional adult model showing the lifted crown, wispy side-swept fringe, and feathered sections that open around the cheeks and nape.
patternDescription: The short layers are styled with loose separation and outward feathering. The finish is illustrative and does not claim a natural hair subtype.
lengthDescription: Short overall, with airy crown and fringe layers, side pieces around ear level, and slightly longer feathered sections at the nape.
